property_summary: For any caller sending exactly 10 ether to C.fallback, the reference contract enforces that the call will only succeed if block.timestamp is strictly greater than the stored pastBlockTime (so a call that succeeds guarantees pastBlockTime increases), whereas the mutant removes that ordering check and therefore can accept a call at the same timestamp and leave pastBlockTime unchanged, violating this rule.
change_summary: Remove the require that block.timestamp is greater than pastBlockTime, allowing repeated calls in same timestamp to update pastBlockTime and possibly change transfer timing.
